description: One class or visibility per field (ROUNDS-14-L01). Ids: pb:<collection> for a record's id, created, and updated; pb:<collection>.<field>, with an optional JSON pointer; storage:<key family>; def:<schema>#<pointer>; request:<purpose>#<pointer> for an input with no stored home; and <entity>.<field> once ROUNDS-08-L01 defines entities. An entry covers the pointers below it, and a deeper entry may only tighten. A row names the ROUNDS-01-L02 row whose floor the entry may not loosen. The privacy rule fails on any field, key, or definition property missing here.
